title: Pay gaming machine tax
what: Pay gaming machine tax on the gross revenue from gaming machines each tax period.

sources.title: Gaming Machine Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 159(1) (current republication (R65, from 1 January 2026; Gaming Machine Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: Gaming machine tax is payable on the gross revenue in relation to the operation of gaming machines each tax period, whether or not the operation is lawful
